verdict.rationale: Open-protocol access and standards-based export are a fair axis for an email client, but the evidence contains no Shortwave-documented IMAP, JMAP or SMTP access or export capability. Users report it works only with Gmail and lacks IMAP support. The low lock-in one user describes (deleting Shortwave and returning to Gmail) comes from the host platform, not from Shortwave, so it earns no credit.
